survey: A cowboy hat seen from slightly above and in front, floating centered on a blue sunburst background with no ground plane. The brim is a wide, flat oval with a raised cream rim lip. It reads as a true ellipse about 0.45 times as tall as it is wide, and its back edge shows behind the crown. The crown rises straight up from the middle of the brim, with vertical sides and a pinched, creased top. Some of the top surface is visible, which matches the raised camera. The red band wraps the base of the crown. Its top and bottom edges curve downward at the front, as a ring seen from above should. The crown's base sits on the brim's center, so the crown meets the brim squarely. Brim, band and crown top all agree on one camera.
